text: LiteRT's add_values_to_cache kernel writes FP16/FP32 K and V into a uint8 cache by clamping to [-128 x scale, 127 x scale], subtracting the minimum, multiplying by 1 / scale and rounding, so each byte holds the INT8 value plus 128.
verifier_note: add_values_to_cache_kernel.cc 93-114: for float src and uint8 cache, min=-128s, max=127s, inverse 1/s; 151-162: clamp, subtract min, multiply inverse, round, convert to uchar4. byte = round(x/s + 128) = round(x/s) + 128.

text: LiteRT's add_values_to_cache kernel writes token X of a run at cache index params[0] + X and skips it when that index reaches cache_size or params[1]; with is_ring_buffer it instead writes at (params[0] + X) mod cache_size for X below params[3].
verifier_note: add_values_to_cache_kernel.cc 125-143: token_index = params[0] + X, return if >= cache_size or >= params[1]; ring buffer: return if X >= params[3], index (params[0] + X) % cache_size.

text: add_values_to_cache writes the K cache in the OSpatialIOGroupO4I4 layout (outputs = tokens) and the V cache in OSpatialIOGroupI4O4 (inputs = tokens); the delegate types quantized cache outputs as kUint8, and for those the kernel writes one byte per element.
